components.name: dataset
values: adamson et al. k562 crispr interference dataset
replogle et al. k562 crispr interference dataset
replogle et al. rpe1 crispr interference dataset

components.name: method
values: gears | deep learning model using gene ontology annotations to extrapolate to unseen perturbations version 0.1.2.
geneformer with linear decoder | fine-tuned by predicting perturbation labels with linear ridge regression decoder.

linear model lm | represents each read-out gene with a k-dimensional vector gene embedding g and each perturbation with an l-dimensional vector perturbation embedding p . g and p are derived via pca from training data or from pretrained embeddings. w is found via ridge regression λ=0.1 . predicts as y_hat = g w p t + b where b is the row mean of training data.
lm with g from scfoundation | linear model using gene embedding g extracted from scfoundation s pretrained model weights.
lm with g from scgpt | linear model using gene embedding g extracted from scgpt following their gene regulatory inference tutorial.
lm with p from gears | linear model using perturbation embedding p derived from gears gene ontology annotations via spectral embedding.
lm with p from replogle data | linear model using a perturbation embedding p derived from 10-dimensional pca on the perturbation means of the replogle dataset cross-cell-line pretraining .
mean baseline | predicts the mean expression across training perturbations for any unseen perturbation.
scbert with linear decoder | fine-tuned on perturbation labels with linear ridge regression decoder.
scgpt | single-cell foundation model parameters and code from perturbation prediction tutorial.
uce with linear decoder | single-cell foundation model zero-shot with linear ridge regression decoder.

values: number of perturbations included in analysis
relative prediction error vs mean baseline

components.name: task
values: prediction of effects for unseen single perturbations on three datasets adamson et al. k562 replogle et al. k562 and rpe1 . models compared against mean baseline and linear model baseline. benchmark repeated twice using gears train-test splitting procedure.

components.name: dataset
values: norman et al. k562 crispr activation dataset

components.name: method
values: additive baseline | predicts expression for double perturbation of genes a and b as y_a + y_b - y_control using mean observed expression of single perturbations.
cpa | compositional perturbation autoencoder used with code from tutorial on combinatorial crispr perturbations on norman dataset version 0.8.8.
gears | deep learning model for perturbation prediction used with default parameters version 0.1.2.
geneformer with linear decoder | fine-tuned by predicting perturbation labels used built-in in silico perturbation to compute perturbed embedding. linear ridge regression decoder.
no change baseline | predicts for each double perturbation the expression values of the control condition.
scbert with linear decoder | fine-tuned on predicting perturbation labels post-perturbation embedding by overwriting perturbed gene rows. linear ridge regression decoder as for uce.
scfoundation | single-cell foundation model trained for 5 epochs with fine-tuning time limited to 3 days.
scgpt | single-cell foundation model fine-tuned using parameters and code from the scgpt tutorial for perturbation prediction.

uce with linear decoder | single-cell foundation model used zero-shot four-layer version. post-perturbation embedding computed by overwriting perturbed gene rows with ground truth expression. linear ridge regression decoder fitted on training data to predict gene expression from perturbed embeddings.

components.name: task
values: prediction of expression changes after double perturbations using data from norman et al. with 100 single-gene and 124 double-gene crispr activation perturbations in k562 cells. models were fine-tuned on all 100 single and 62 double perturbations and tested on the remaining 62 double perturbations repeated across 5 random train-test splits.
